integrity: One integral all-parameter theorem with finite modular tests as corroboration; no claim of independent validation or of exhaustive publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted trees, inclusive ordered length nerves at positive integer stages, and fixed-vertex-free involutive symmetries for the quotient theorem. No conclusion for weighted graphs, fixed-vertex involutions, or unordered Rips complexes.
title: Real-projective quotients of finite-tree enriched length nerves
